mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.2% triggers bearish sentiment as investors anticipate prolonged economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 6.2% threshold, or IC > 0.03 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and business activity (HOUST) above their 50-day moving averages signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST cross above their 50-day moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies exceeding thresholds, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected drop in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals policy divergence from expectations, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops below 4.0% in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite the FEDFUNDS drop, or IC < 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above trend signals robust supply-side expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite rising INDPRO, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105.0 triggers optimism about supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite INDPRO crossing above 105.0, or IC < 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both labor demand (PAYEMS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) above their 50-day moving averages signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and GDPC1 cross above their 50-day moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies exceeding thresholds, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate below 6.5% signals improving labor market conditions, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.5% in high-unemployment regime
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite UNRATE dropping below 6.5%, or IC < 0.03 over the period.
